cases.disease: X-linked intellectual disability (family history of XL ID)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 4,902-bp insertion containing SVA and L1 sequence in the HCFC1 3' UTR (likely maternally inherited) lengthens the predicted 3' UTR from 1,791 to 6,693 nt; 3'-end RNA-seq showed ~8.8-fold lower HCFC1 expression in the proband than his father. Classified VUS (case-level Uncertain).
cases.quote: HiFi sequencing identified a 4902 bp mobile element insertion (MEI) in the 3′ UTR of HCFC1 (Chr X:153948602_ins4902), consisting of both SVA and L1 sequence (Fig. 3B).
